questions.explanation:
## Why This Question Matters
This evaluates production caching design for LLM gateways with strict compliance (data residency), multi-tenant isolation, and performance requirements (p95 <200ms latency).

## Key Concepts

### Regional Shard-Aware Routing
- Use consistent hashing (Ketama algorithm) on tenantId
- Route requests to region-specific cache shards
- Ensures prompts stay in the tenant's designated region for compliance

### Cache Key Design
- Format: `tenantId|region|policyVersion|xxHash3(prompt)`
- Provides uniqueness, locality awareness, and fast hashing

### Multi-Tenant Isolation
- Per-tenant TTLs control how long prompts stay cached
- Per-tenant memory budgets prevent any tenant from dominating cache space
- ARC eviction adapts to access patterns while respecting tenant boundaries

### Performance & Reliability
- Token bucket rate limiters handle burst traffic
- Circuit breakers prevent cascade failures
- Write-through caching ensures consistency between cache and backend

## Test Plan
- Generate synthetic workloads to simulate traffic patterns
- Verify p95 latency stays under 200ms
- Check drift between cached and actual policy versions

## Why This Is Asked
This question evaluates the ability to design robust, privacy-preserving guardrails operating at the edge of an LLM gateway. It tests understanding of real-time threat detection, per-tenant policy enforcement, auditable logging with encryption, safe-path routing strategies, and performance validation.

## Key Concepts
- Multi-tenant isolation with dedicated policy stores
- Real-time threat detection: prompt injection, data exfiltration, jailbreak attempts
- PII redaction and granular privacy controls
- Tamper-evident, KMS-encrypted audit logs
- Conditional routing to guard-path model variants
- Latency budgetting and drift testing

## Implementation Considerations
- Deploy a sidecar proxy or API gateway plugin for each tenant to ensure isolation
- Use regex-based and ML-based classifiers for injection detection
- Implement redact-on-match patterns with tenant-specific PII regexes
- Write audit logs to an append-only store with KMS-managed encryption keys
- Route prompts through a scoring engine; threshold breaches trigger guard-path routing
- Target p99 latency under 50ms for the protection layer

}
